notes.title: Build ready for the Comiccon!
notes.content: New sounds, new quests, everything is more polished. Bonne fête du Canada! (oui, un peu en retard)

notes.title: First post-steam-next beta
notes.content:
Many new musics, a lot of new code and many exciting rooms that still aren't available outside our own team... don't worry, it's coming! 

Thanks again to all of you for your support during the Steam Next event. Bonne journée et bonne fin de semaine!

notes.title: Beta v1.0.181
notes.content: New music tracks are finally here! Enjoy.

notes.title: New Music!
notes.content: Chapter 4 is coming soon, we're finishing up a couple of things in the desert of Sector C. Appart from that, a lot of things have been updated everywhere and for the first time, you'll be hearing what the final sound track will be like!

notes.title: Update for the 14th of May
notes.content: The current playtest version has been updated to match the demo that will be distributed during the Steam Next Fest. Have fun testing it!

notes.title: Everything's better!
notes.content: Chapters 1, 2 and 3 are now fully playable. Enjoy!

notes.title: Important Update About the Playtest
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest in our playtest! We want to inform you that the game is currently only available in French. An English version is not available at this time.

If you have any questions or want to share your feedback, feel free to join us on Discord -> [url=https://discord.com/invite/D2Qq2ZgJzg]click here[/url]! You’ll find the link on our Steam store page. We’d love to chat with you and hear your thoughts!
